board: Adafruit LSM6DSO32 6-DoF Accelerometer and Gyroscope - STEMMA QT / Qwiic (#4692)
reason: Check PASSED on esp32 and pico. Byte-register model (WHO_AM_I 0x6C, address 0x6A) with little-endian signed outputs at ST's LSM6DSO32 sensitivities: 0.122 mg/LSB (±4 g, FS_XL 00), 8.75 mdps/LSB (±250 dps), 25 + raw/256 °C; driver uses the DSO32-specific FS_XL coding (00=4g, 01=32g, 10=8g, 11=16g). ST's PDF host timed out, so register values were taken from ST's official lsm6dso32-pid driver; only the 9-pin main header is modelled.
breakoutPinoutSource: Adafruit #4692 top-side pinout photo https://cdn-learn.adafruit.com/assets/assets/000/094/956/medium640/sensors__032_pinouts4692-04.png (bottom row silkscreen: VIN, 3Vo, GND, SCL, SDA, DO, CS, I1, I2) plus https://learn.adafruit.com/lsm6dsox-and-ism330dhc-6-dof-imu/pinouts
